name: Buitoni Four Cheese Ravioli (Boiled Soft, Mild Butter Toss)
whyItWorks: Tender refrigerated egg pasta filled with smooth ricotta and parmesan. Provides soft protein and calories in remission; avoid heavy red sauces or garlic.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Gently boil for 6 minutes in water. Drain carefully and toss with 1 tsp butter and fresh chopped sage or parmesan.
